name: vibooks
description: Bookkeeping software for AI agents, from source documents to reconciled books.

interface.shortDescription: Turn source documents into reviewable, reconciled books with Vibooks software
interface.longDescription: Use your AI agent with Vibooks, professional bookkeeping software for small businesses and bookkeeping firms. Turn receipts, bills, invoices, and bank or card statements into source-linked, reviewable records. Record transactions through proper workflows, reconcile accounts, independently review entries, and prepare for month end. Books stay on your device by default, and every write remains user-controlled.
defaultPrompt: Set up Vibooks on this computer and verify it is ready for bookkeeping.
Record the receipts, bills, invoices, and statements in this folder in Vibooks.
Reconcile my bank and card statements and prepare a month-end review.
